basics.name: Ben Weibel
basics.label: Senior WordPress Developer | Plugins + Blocks | Performance + SEO | Content Systems
basics.summary: Senior full-stack web engineer (15+ years) specializing in WordPress platform engineering and modern JavaScript (TypeScript/React + strong vanilla JS). Hands-on technical lead for agency/consulting engagements: discovery/estimation, plugin architecture, custom Gutenberg/ACF blocks, content modeling (CPT/taxonomies), and integrations (HubSpot, CF7, The Events Calendar). Known for performance/SEO-first delivery (TTFB/CWV triage), security-minded implementation, and high-polish front ends (spacing/typography/layout) that match design intent. Comfortable owning roadmaps, writing SOPs/documentation, mentoring, and debugging production systems across Linux/Docker/logs.

work.name: Wordfence
highlights: Investigate compromised web applications and infrastructure, identify infection vectors, remove malicious persistence mechanisms, and restore operational integrity.
Perform forensic analysis and IOC collection across production WordPress environments, plugins, themes, server configurations, and third-party integrations.
Triage and validate vulnerability disclosures from bug bounty submissions, reproducing issues and assessing exploitability and operational impact.
Harden application and hosting environments through configuration review, access remediation, plugin auditing, and operational security improvements.

work.name: bweib LLC
work.summary: Independent web consulting and development for small businesses/nonprofits (WordPress-focused).
highlights: Own end-to-end delivery: discovery, SOWs/estimates, architecture, implementation, launch, and maintenance retainers.
Build custom WordPress plugins and Gutenberg/ACF blocks as reusable primitives; ship composable components used across templates, patterns, and partner pages.
Deliver modern FSE sites using a custom base block theme + theme.json design tokens to ensure editor/front-end parity and consistent UX polish.
Create repeatable content delivery SOPs (pattern conventions, QA checks, release notes) so non-technical teams can publish at speed without regressions.
Lead performance/security hardening: TTFB/CWV triage, query hotspots, cache strategy, third-party script budgets, and secure WP patterns (caps/nonces/sanitization).
Handle hosting/DNS/email and incident response; troubleshoot production issues across Linux/Docker/logs and document fixes via runbooks/notes for continuity.
Primary full-time focus since early 2025; previously delivered alongside full-time roles.

Built and maintained custom plugins/blocks for content teams, including React-based, editor-friendly abstractions and reusable components shared across multiple sites.

Improved Core Web Vitals and scalability across dozens of WP/Magento builds; focused on authenticated TTFB, query profiling, cache strategy, and third-party script budgets (Lighthouse/PageSpeed/WebPageTest).
Delivered integrations (HubSpot/CF7/The Events Calendar-style pipelines) with idempotent sync, failure logging, and retry-safe workflows to prevent double-creates and silent drops.
Led emergency recovery and platform updates for a portfolio of 15 large-scale Magento sites; introduced version control, repeatable release workflows, and an upgrade cadence.
Led support for production sites through maintenance and ticket queues; debugged issues spanning front-end behavior, API constraints, and platform/plugin interactions.
Conducted PR reviews and mentored devs on WP patterns, performance, and secure coding.
